acceptanceCriteria.text: The Route 4 provider profile/schema binds the exact immutable QEMU firmware/data artifact required by the supported QEMU closure.
Deployment descriptor production carries that identity from the authoritative release provider profile without recomputing or dropping it.
The standalone Route 4 consumer can derive/verify the complete QEMU system + image + data requirement from the selected release profile.
A descriptor whose data-artifact identity differs from managed QEMU state fails closed before provider use.
Regression coverage proves changing only the QEMU data-artifact identity changes/rejects the complete provider identity.
The design composes with #826: this Issue binds the release-level data artifact identity; #826 proves the activated/extracted data closure still matches the accepted identity during reconciliation.
The QEMU identity remains one coherent provider/toolchain contract rather than adding another independent identity formula.

issue.title: fix(runtime): bind the QEMU data closure into the Route 4 deployment identity
